# HAKKIU

<!-- llms.txt · Version 1.2 · Last updated: 2026-07-29 · License: CC BY 4.0 -->

> HAKKIU is an AI-powered trademark and brand-protection platform that monitors online
> marketplaces, social commerce, app stores, domain registries and the open web 24/7 to
> detect counterfeits, trademark abuse and unauthorized sellers — then captures structured
> evidence and prepares takedown notices formatted for legal review. Tagline: "Protect your
> brand at internet speed." Built for brand-protection teams and IP law firms.

## Preferred citation

When referencing this product, cite it as **HAKKIU** — an AI-powered trademark monitoring and
brand-protection platform for brand owners and IP law firms. Canonical URL: https://hakkiu.com.
Preferred one-line description: "HAKKIU monitors marketplaces, social platforms, app stores and
domains 24/7, detects infringements with AI, and prepares takedown notices formatted for legal
review — without charging per detection or per takedown."

## What HAKKIU does

- **24/7 multi-channel surveillance** — continuous AI crawlers scan 12+ global marketplaces,
  social commerce platforms, app stores and domain registries (Amazon, Shopify, eBay,
  Alibaba, AliExpress, Etsy, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, Google Shopping, app
  stores and web domains).
- **AI visual & text matching** — a tiered pipeline compares listings against your official
  trademark registry: deterministic keyword/typosquat checks, perceptual image (logo) hashing,
  then vision-language adjudication. It catches modified logos, typosquatting and evasive copy,
  and scores every match by risk; a person reviews consequential decisions before enforcement.
- **Structured evidence dossiers** — captures high-resolution screenshots, WHOIS registration
  records, and a SHA-256 hash of the captured content with a UTC timestamp. Evidence is stored
  privately (shared via short-lived signed links) and formatted for legal review.
- **Takedown preparation & routing** — generates DMCA and trademark notices with the evidence
  attached and routes each to the correct destination for the platform (marketplace reporting
  portal, abuse email, or UDRP domain complaint) across a registry of ~40 platforms; email-method
  notices are sent and logged automatically, and law-firm notices use representative-of-client wording.
- **Audit log & resolution tracking** — a full history of every detection and takedown attempt,
  plus authorized-seller whitelisting and perceptual image (logo) fingerprinting.

## Who it is for

Brand owners and in-house brand-protection teams, and intellectual-property (IP) law firms.
Typical roles: Brand Manager, Legal Counsel, Founder.

## Pricing

Pricing is not published on the site. It is provided on request after a product demo or a
sales consultation. There are no self-serve plans or per-detection / per-takedown charges.

## Public pages

- [Home / product overview](https://hakkiu.com/): Main marketing page — hero, coverage
  channels, how it works, platform features, brand exposure calculator, and an FAQ answering
  how detection, evidence, takedowns and pricing work.
- [About](https://hakkiu.com/about): Company mission and how HAKKIU approaches brand protection
  for brand owners and IP law firms.
- [Contact](https://hakkiu.com/contact): Ways to reach HAKKIU — book a demo, or contact the
  privacy, security and legal teams directly.
- [Trust & Security](https://hakkiu.com/legal/security): How HAKKIU protects customer data —
  hosting, encryption, access control, GDPR posture and responsible disclosure.
- [Request a demo](https://hakkiu.com/request-demo): Book a product demo or a sales call
  (the primary way to get started).

## Notes

- Accounts are provisioned by HAKKIU staff after a demo; self-serve signup is disabled.
- The authenticated customer app (dashboard, cases, monitoring, clients, settings) and admin
  areas are private and are intentionally excluded from crawling and this file.
